resources.string:
"Tutankhamun needs the files of your own Pharaoh + Cleopatra 2.1 (GOG, Steam or the CD-ROM version updated to 2.1) to run. Please follow these steps:

1. Copy your whole Pharaoh + Cleopatra folder (the one with Data, campaign.txt and Pharaoh_Text.eng) from your computer to your Android device, with USB file transfer or a similar tool.

2. Select that folder with the button below. The game also keeps your players and saved games there, as the original does."
